sensitivity.assumption: Production/opportunity means ±10%; not a confidence interval

assessment.reason: The over at +171 clears the model's fair price of about +132 and its minimum of about +156. The lower sensitivity bound still sits above the +171 break-even. The goalie conflict could matter, but either answer appears unlikely to undercut the over.
assessment.model_case: The projected mean is about 0.57 points on 17.8 minutes, with a median of zero, so a single point is needed. The weakness is unverified line and power-play role. A shrunk production rate limits how much any one adjustment drives the case.
assessment.price_case: Single line at 0.5; +171 needs to win a bit more than one time in three. Three books in total quote this market, and the de-vigged market sits just above break-even. The edge relies on model disagreement, not broad consensus.
assessment.context_case: The model gives Thompson a 74 in 100 start likelihood, yet a listing of unknown publication time shows him on IR. Flyers wing absences could change Dvorak's linemates and power-play usage either way.

qualitative_review.countercase: If Dvorak lands in a checking role without power-play time, or if Flyers injuries weaken his linemates, his points rate could fall below the shrunk estimate. Philadelphia's offense may also be thin overall. Market pricing near break-even suggests books see little value at this number.

Check Dvorak's line and power-play unit given Flyers wing absences.

rows.goalie_assumption: Projected, not confirmed. Opposing goalie, Edmonton Oilers: likely Devon Levi 51% (sv 0.900), Tristan Jarry 49%.
rows.lineup_assumption: Participation required for action; current role and active lineup unconfirmed

sensitivity.assumption: Production/opportunity means ±10%; not a confidence interval

assessment.reason: The under at -190 is better than the model's minimum of about -258. The whole sensitivity range stays above the -190 break-even. Erasing the edge would require a much larger assist rate than the plus-or-minus tenth stress tests.
assessment.model_case: The projected mean is about 0.28 assists on 17.4 minutes, with a median of zero. The main weakness is that a shrunk rate could understate Farabee if he moves into a top-six or first power-play role.
assessment.price_case: Single line at 0.5; -190 needs roughly two wins in three. Only two books quote this market, so the market estimate is thin. The model's gap of about nine points needs scrutiny but is not implausible for a depth-scoring winger.
assessment.context_case: The model's goalie assumption gives Levi a 51 in 100 start likelihood, but the listing places him on IR. That points to a different Edmonton starter, with a likely small effect on assists. A Calgary center absence could shift Farabee's usage.

qualitative_review.countercase: With a Calgary center out, Farabee could be promoted to a scoring line or the top power-play unit. That would lift his assist chances above the shrunk estimate. Thin two-book coverage also means the model gap may reflect information the model lacks, not a mispriced line.

Confirm Edmonton's starting goalie given Levi's IR listing.
Reconfirm -190 is still available and the line has not moved.
Verify the book's assist settlement rules.

assessment.reason: The under at -190 is better than the model's minimum of about -258. The whole sensitivity range stays above the -190 break-even. Erasing the edge would require a much larger assist rate than the plus-or-minus tenth stress tests.
assessment.model_case: The projected mean is about 0.28 assists on 17.4 minutes, with a median of zero. The main weakness is that a shrunk rate could understate Farabee if he moves into a top-six or first power-play role.
assessment.price_case: Single line at 0.5; -190 needs roughly two wins in three. Only two books quote this market, so the market estimate is thin. The model's gap of about nine points needs scrutiny but is not implausible for a depth-scoring winger.
assessment.context_case: The model's goalie assumption gives Levi a 51 in 100 start likelihood, but the listing places him on IR. That points to a different Edmonton starter, with a likely small effect on assists. A Calgary center absence could shift Farabee's usage.

qualitative_review.countercase: With a Calgary center out, Farabee could be promoted to a scoring line or the top power-play unit. That would lift his assist chances above the shrunk estimate. Thin two-book coverage also means the model gap may reflect information the model lacks, not a mispriced line.
